subject: StratoWorks renewal: path to marketplace commitment
messages:
From: Anna Cho <anna.cho@stratoworks.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Mari Ross <mari.ross@stratoworks.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:30 -0700
Subject: Renewal timeline & billing options for Redwood

Hi Tessa —

Our annual agreement with Redwood is up for renewal 2027-06-30 (Contract #RDW-STRAT-2024). Procurement is evaluating whether we should convert to AWS Marketplace billing for simplicity and consolidated invoicing.

Quick questions to help us decide:
- If we move to Marketplace, what is the effective date mechanics (does billing switch on the next invoice or at the end of the term)?
- Are there any list-price vs committed-discount differences we should expect for our committed reserved capacity?
- Will Redwood provide a one-year commitment SKU that maps to our existing reserved pool?

Attached is our standard procurement questionnaire and the renewal worksheet for your finance team. Our Finance lead (Mari Ross) is copied — she will need the amendment language for internal sign-off.

Can we book a 30-minute sync next week with you + someone from partnerships (to talk about co-sell credits) and AWS Marketplace if possible?

Thanks,
Anna Cho
Procurement Manager
StratoWorks
[Attachment: procurement_qs.xlsx (XLSX)]
[Attachment: Strato_MA_Renewal_2027.pdf (PDF)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.inference.com>
To: Anna Cho <anna.cho@stratoworks.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 11:03:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal timeline & billing options for Redwood

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear note and attachments. Short answers up front:

- Effective date: Marketplace billing typically starts on the effective date in the Marketplace amendment; we can align that to 2027-07-01 (start of your next term) so there is no gap in entitlement.
- Pricing/commitment: We can map an annual commitment SKU to the reserved capacity you have today. Committed pricing on Marketplace will be slightly different (we price via SKU), but we can offer a transitional credit to keep your effective unit economics comparable for the first year.
- Co-sell: We can work with AWS to capture co-sell credits on expansion bookings; we'll coordinate with our marketplace partner manager.

I attached a short "conversion playbook" that outlines the steps, timeline, and required artifacts from StratoWorks (PO/PO# mapping, AWSPAR, signer for contract amendment). Proposed timeline:
  - Apr 19: internal alignment + handoff to partnerships
  - Apr 22: joint call with AWS Marketplace rep + StratoWorks (30 min)
  - May 6: Marketplace amendment signed and SKUs enabled
  - Jul 1: Billing flips to Marketplace, charge appears on AWS invoice

If that looks reasonable I'll get Lauren to prepare the amendment language and Priyom to draft the pricing carve (recommended 10% transitional credit for year 1). Are you available Apr 22 at 10:00 AM PT for a quick joint call?

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0123
[Attachment: Redwood_Strato_conversion_playbook_v1.pdf (PDF)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 08:55:10 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal timeline & billing options for Redwood — StratoWorks (internal)

Team — forwarding Anna's procurement note and our reply. Quick internal recommendations before the call:

- Pricing approach: propose a 12-month Marketplace SKU that equals current committed spend; apply a 10% one-time transitional credit year 1 to offset SKU/listing differences. Priyom, please draft the amendment language + credit line.
- Partnerships: Marcus, please invite our AWS Marketplace rep and confirm co-sell routing (we want co-sell on any expansion + ensure we capture CPD).
- Legal/Finance: Lauren, prepare an amendment with two options:
    1) Marketplace amendment (preferred): amendment + SKU mapping; billing moves 7/1/2027.
    2) Short-term extension: 60-day extension on current contract if Marketplace approval slips.

Attached: Anna's original attachments and my playbook for the conversion steps. Goal: keep procurement happy and avoid any interruption to entitlement on 7/1.

Let me know who will own each bullet — I'd like owners before the Apr 22 call.

Thanks,
Tessa

Subject: RE: StratoWorks renewal: onboarding & next steps

Hi Tessa and Anna —

Thanks for the invite; happy to join the Apr 22 sync. Confirming next steps from the Marketplace side and items we need to complete to get StratoWorks onto AWS billing:

1) Marketplace SKUs: Redwood will publish a 12-month commitment SKU. We need the SKU metadata (term, price, included units) and the entitlement mapping to StratoWorks' account (AWSPRID / Payer info).
2) Amendment: AWS supports a Marketplace amendment that authorizes the listing and establishes billing. DocuSign workflow is recommended — please provide signer name and email.
3) Effective date & proration: If we set an effective date of 2027-07-01, AWS billing will start on that date; charges appear on the first AWS invoice after activation. Proration may apply depending on activation time during billing cycle.
4) Co-sell: I'll open a co-sell request and route to the regional GTM team; to capture co-sell we need a brief partner MOU and the HubSpot deal ID (please confirm).

Attached is an onboarding checklist and the vendor MOU template. I can also circulate a DocuSign envelope for the amendment once Lauren shares the amendment draft.

Links: AWS onboarding checklist (attached), DocuSign template: https://www.docusign.com/embedded/abcdef123456
HubSpot reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/98765

Best,
Carmen Delgado

aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com
